## Summary of the last run

The page is a careful treatment of solvability by radicals. I checked the lemmas, the main Galois theorem proof, the S_5 example, and the supplement. The casus irreducibilis remark is the classical correct statement. The S_5 example correctly uses Eisenstein, Rolle/IVT for root counting, Cauchy for the 5-cycle, and complex conjugation for the transposition.
